   "newText": "def transform(grid):
    """Extract the top-left quadrant of the non-background pattern."""
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v != 0]
    if not cells:
        return []
    r0 = min(r for r, _ in cells)
    r1 = max(r for r, _ in cells)
    c0 = min(c for _, c in cells)
    c1 = max(c for _, c in cells)
    h, w = (r1 - r0 + 1) // 2, (c1 - c0 + 1) // 2
    return [row[c0:c0 + w] for row in grid[r0:r0 + h]]
"
  }
 ]
